subject: Getting started with Redwood — 20m walkthrough
messages:
From: aditya.rao@redwood.ai
To: Erin Coleman <erin@brightgrid.io>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Welcome to Redwood — quick 20m walkthrough

Hi Erin,

Thanks for signing up for a free trial of Redwood — excited to have BrightGrid onboard. I noticed you completed the self-serve signup earlier today. If you want a short walkthrough to help map Redwood to your use case, I can put you with one of our engineers for a 20-minute session.

Here’s a quick summary and a link to pick a slot if you’d like:
- What we cover: quick account tour, demo of inference latency/cost dashboard, and tips for getting predictable throughput.
- Duration: 20 minutes (we keep it tight).
- Prep: nothing required — bring any sample prompts or a short list of goals.

Pick a time that works for you: https://calendly.com/redwood-sdr/20min

I’ve also attached a short PDF with setup tips and what to expect (redwood-getting-started.pdf).

If none of the available times work, reply with a few windows and my teammate will follow up with alternate evening options.

—
Aditya Rao
Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai

Attachment: redwood-getting-started.pdf (7 pages — quick checklist)

From: Erin Coleman <erin@brightgrid.io>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 12:08:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Welcome to Redwood — quick 20m walkthrough

Thanks, Aditya — appreciate the quick note.

I tried the Calendly link but most times are during our morning (we're East Coast). Do you have any evening slots (US ET after 6pm) next week? Ideally someone with product/technical context so we can run through latency and private deployment questions.

Also, what should my engineering lead bring to the session? We might want to invite him.

Best,
Erin Coleman
Product Ops | BrightGrid
erin@brightgrid.io
